padding_value.description: the value to be inserted as padding. Must have the same dtype as ``operand``.

padding_config.description: a sequence of ``(low, high, interior)`` tuples of integers, giving the amount of low, high, and interior (dilation) padding to insert in each dimension. Negative values for ``low`` and ``high`` are allowed and remove elements from the edges of the array.

output.description: The ``operand`` array with padding value ``padding_value`` inserted in each dimension according to the ``padding_config``.

constraints: padding_value dtype must match operand dtype
